content: Our team launched the AI Observatory, an independent public resource for measuring real-world AI use, with a feature on The Washington Post homepage and a long-form article in MIT Technology Review. The Technology Review article highlights WildChat as one of the Observatory's largest and most detailed datasets.

content: Wrote an article, "From AI as Problem Solver to AI as Tool Builder", on my view that pretraining models to compile repeated tasks into small reusable neural programs (ProgramAsWeights) is one of the most exciting future directions in AI.

content: Built a 3D character you can control with language instead of predefined buttons - a ProgramAsWeights neural program turns instructions like "act excited, wave, dance, then sit proudly" into movements.

content: WildChat was featured in the Washington Post! This work collected 1M real-world user-ChatGPT conversations. You can explore all data at wildvisualizer.com, or try our data-collecting chatbot at huggingface.co/spaces/yuntian-deng/ChatGPT4.

content: I built a demo using GPT-2 to directly produce the product of two numbers without chain-of-thought (CoT). CoT is internalized using the approach in From Explicit CoT to Implicit CoT: Learning to Internalize CoT Step by Step. A 12-layer GPT-2 can solve 20-digit multiplication with 99.5% accuracy!

content: I built a demo to solve grade school math problems (GSM8K) without chain-of-thought (CoT) at 52% accuracy. CoT is internalized using the approach in From Explicit CoT to Implicit CoT: Learning to Internalize CoT Step by Step.

content: Our paper, From Explicit CoT to Implicit CoT: Learning to Internalize CoT Step by Step, is now publicly available! This paper proposes a simple yet effective method to teach language models to internalize chain-of-thought reasoning by gradually removing intermediate steps and finetuning.
title: Our paper, From Explicit CoT to Implicit CoT: Learning to Internalize CoT Step by Step, is now publicly available! This paper proposes a simple yet effective method to teach language models to internalize chain-of-thought reasoning by gradually removing intermediate steps and finetuning.

content: Our dataset, WildChat, is now publicly available! It is a corpus of 650K real-world user-ChatGPT interactions, characterized by over 60 languages and a diversity of user prompts.

content: Our paper, Model Criticism for Long-Form Text Generation, is now publicly available! This paper uses model criticism in latent space to quantify various notions of high-level coherence in long-form text generation.

content: Our paper, Cascaded Text Generation with Markov Transformers, is available! It allows parallel, fast, autoregressive, and accurate text generation using a high-order Markov model.

content: Introducing Residual Energy-Based Models for Text Generation, a globally-normalized approach to text generation! Our approach uses a global discriminator to guide the traditional locally-normalized language model to produce text that's more indistinguishable from human-written text.
